purpose: Field guide only; return result.schema.json data, not this guide as a completed result.
inventory: Complete caller-pinned path/kind/length/hash inventory, including preservation-only files; do not claim to have recalculated hashes.
coverage: Exactly one reviewed/preservation-only/unavailable row per inventory path, with a rationale.
criteria: Every fixed criterion ID with outcome, rationale and pinned citations for applicable substantive opinions.
findings: Stable ID, criterionId, CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFO severity, confidence, actual source citations, rationale and actionable correction.
citation: sourceId selects candidate or one declared evidence pin; path is candidate-relative or the input basename. Include pinned sha256, logical startLine/endLine and an actual bounded quote.
deterministicEvidence: Mirror every selected caller check's id/status/exit/rawSha256/receiptSha256; observations do not authenticate execution.
status: reviewed/partial/blocked with no-blocking-findings/changes-requested/inconclusive opinion; a blocked review needs an open item.
persistence: Return data. The caller saves and checks the actual result.json path; the worker cannot claim to have written it.
